Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: يَا سَالِخَ النَّهَارِ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَإِذَا نَحْنُ مُظْلِمُوْنَ
Translation: O You who strips the day from the night, and behold we are in darkness

Arabic text: وَمُجْرِيَ الشَّمْسِ لِمُسْتَقَرِّهَا بِتَقْدِيرِكَ يَا عَزِيزُ يَا عَلِيمُ
Translation: And You who causes the sun to run to its resting place by Your decree, O Mighty, O All-Knowing

Arabic text: وَمُقَدِّرَ الْقَمَرِ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَالْعُرْجُونِ الْقَدِيمِ
Translation: And You who determines the phases of the moon until it returns like an old palm stalk
O Light of all lights
And ultimate goal of all desires
And Guardian of all blessings
O Allah, O Most Compassionate
O Allah, O Most Holy

Arabic text: يَا اَحَدُ يَا وَاحِدُ يَا فَرْدُ
Translation: O One, O Unique, O Singular

Arabic text: يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ
Translation: O Allah, O Allah, O Allah
To You belong the most beautiful names
And the highest examples
And greatness and bounties

Arabic text: اَسْئَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: وَاَنْ تَجْعَلَ اسْمِيْ فِيْ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ فِيْ السُّعَدَاءِ
Translation: And to make my name, on this night, among the fortunate ones
And my soul with the martyrs
And my good deeds in the highest places
And my misdeeds forgiven

Arabic text: وَاَنْ تَهَبَ لِيْ يَقِينًا تُبَاشِرُ بِهِ قَلْبِي
Translation: And to grant me certainty that fills my heart
And faith that removes doubt from me
And to make me content with what You have apportioned for me
And grant us good in this world
And good in the Hereafter
And protect us from the torment of the burning Fire

Arabic text: وَارْزُقْنِيْ فِيهَا ذِكْرَكَ وَشُكْرَكَ وَالرَّغْبَةَ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: And provide me therein with Your remembrance, Your gratitude, and desire towards You

Arabic text: وَالْاِنَابَةَ وَالتَّوْفِيقَ لِمَا وَفَّقْتَ لَهُ مُحَمَّدًا وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمُ السَّلاَمُ
Translation: And repentance and success in what You granted success to Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, peace be upon him and them
